title: Foundation: synthetic data, trust-state persistence & the Claude intelligence boundary

open_findings.description: synthetic-handle prefix mismatch: plan/SUB-TASK-1 say handle-<n> but AC-13 test asserts /^synthetic-handle-/

accepted_gaps.constraint: Seed MUST emit synthetic handles with literal prefix 'synthetic-handle-' (e.g. synthetic-handle-007), NOT 'handle-<n>'. Stage 7 test-creator must assert /^synthetic-handle-/ in TS-P1-04 and TS-P3-02; Stage 8 code-writer must implement it.

progress_log.note: Story created from PRD + target-state architecture. Local-only run.
